critical_code_review_comments: Server-side cross-team write protection is correctly enforced: PUT /api/team-scoring/hole binds teamId from JWT `sub` (via get_current_team) and returns 409 if body attempts to spoof another team — solid.
Danger Zone reset-scores action correctly resets BOTH scores=[] AND status=not-started in a single atomic update — matches spec.
Captain login error messages are intentionally identical for wrong-PIN (401) and account-not-found (401) to prevent team enumeration — good security posture.

Lockout is per-team-PIN identifier (`pin:{teamId}`), not per-IP — reasonable for the small trusted user set but note that a locked team blocks the legitimate captain too; consider surfacing 429 message clearly in UI (currently the frontend catches the message string and displays it, which does work).
Homepage LeaderboardPreview correctly hides itself when scoring.status === 'not-started' (returns null) — no stale state leaks after cleanup.

React Query cache latency observed (~1-2s) when transitioning between LIVE and not-started; consider `refetchOnWindowFocus` or a shorter staleTime on the /public/scoring key if sub-second freshness is desired on tournament day (nice-to-have, not blocking).
